book.name: Luke
book.title: Luke Yesu da bino dave Luke mi gagurisina.

content: Yesu betarida awa erorisina.
Ango edo Deguta Bajina pura tuturoda sipo ataebéde, eutumai eiwamane ae eutu nenei demi ni igi muno davede siya esitera awa kundo guputera banga toda.
Edo awamane gundo, ganuma to be engiregari awa apepegari demonda maundo isiri gositera.
Awatedo, awamane maundo torido Badari Yesu da tamo ainda tambae esitera.
Edo awamane buro nongo esiri awa kotemain dareite itero, boraebé embo tote (2) demonda petetero awamaneda ombarimi parara bajinabé esisina.
Ango esiri eutumai awa adu edo dombumi butuda atembesitera, ango ero embo tote (2)mi sitera, “Nongaintedo inemane embo wasiride isira, awa bebetegarida toropuda gain kakowa evi?
Embo gain ewa awa einda itae, ata matu erira. Edo ami imondemane daedo eite yai Galili ainda ge nongo siutari awa kotembewo!
Awa engo, ‘Embo da Mai awa kundo embo bebegaeda ipada piara, edo oregada daro betaina, edo deguta tamonde (3) ainda awa tekago eraina.’”
Edo iji angode ge awa ingido, awamane kotembesitera awa gebé, Yesu mi ge ango sisina.
Ango tetero gido eutumai banga toda edo overegedo gundo buro berari eiwa ainda embobo 11 ae ainda ambodani nenei berari de sitera.
Edo eutumai eiwa Mary (nasi Magadala eutu), Joanna, edo James da ai (ainda dao awa daedo Mary), edo eutumai neneinde daedo awamanemi Yesu da piari aimbari emboboda yai ge dá awa tedo esitera.
Ata awamanemi kotembesitera awa, eutumaimi ge tera ainda moka itae, edo awamane gebé ae esitera.

Awarata, Peter erido bé jisimi gain to beda tumundo maunsisina, edo atembedo gongo virarae awa akuta isiri gosisina. Awatedo, Peter mi buro ro idegesira awa gido imo akuta korebé eite overegedo maunsisina.
Yesu, ambodani tote (2) Imeasi begatada mauntero idegesisina.
Ango edo deguta dá ainde, Yesu da ambodani nei tote (2), awamane nasi dao Imeasi tedo era, ainda mauntera. Nasi ainda edo Jerusalem da begata tonga awa ribori 11 km ango.
Awamane wasiri ro berari idegesiri awa ge mina tara edo goteite maunsitera.
Edo awamane tote (2) ge mina tara edo goteite mauntero Yesu imo akuta gundo atutumbedo awamanede daedo pepeta esisina.
Ata God mi awamaneda jisi engiregesiri Yesu gaegae esitera.
Edo Yesu mi awamanede sisina, “Imomane ge awa ro sireite duboveverade ainto evi?”
Embo tote (2) ainda da (1), dao Cleopas mi Yesu de sisina, “Imo etega embo dabé akuta ami Jerusalem ainda sima eto buro ro iji einde idegatari awa gae ta rora!”

Ango tetero, Yesu mi tedogosisina, “Buro ro idegatari?” Edo awamanemi sitera, “Buro awa Yesu Nasaret Embo da yai idegatara. Imo awa peroveta, edo ami ge gorobade tedo esisina, buro babain edo esisina, God da jisida edo embomai berarida jisida.
Awa pirisi babain ae kaenato babadegari demi kundo, Rome da gisijiarida ipada imo katedo dari betarate pietero, ainda itoro embobomi oregada detero besitara.
Ata nakare tumonda edo eutara awa, embo dabé ami Israel embomai bundarida itera awa udegaina. Ainda edo buro engo eutara awa gundo boroko deguta tamonde (3) eira.
Awarata, deguta einde, eutumai nenei natokare doregarida ami gundo nakare tetero gido kore beyaebé etera. Awa eire: sipo ataebéde awamane erido banga toda mambera,
ata Yesu da tamo awa ainda tambae etera. Edo awamanemi overegedo gundo namondekare tetera awa, ‘Nakare jisi viviroda anelamane gera edo awamanemi tetera awa imo wasiride isira.’
Edo natokare doregarida embo nenei banga toda mambera. Edo yai awa tepo, ge ro eutumaimi tetera angó, ata embo awa gae etera.”
Ango tetero Yesu mi awamanede sisina, “Itomane kotembari jigamo ae edo burigi gebé ari tao ae, God da peroveta manemi ge berari sitera ango aina awa.
Ata God da udojipapa awa Keriso, imo memesi engo budo utuda ikaito taogarida torarate.”
Edo Yesu mi awamanede udugedo tesiri gositera, ro berari ainda yai Matu Oveda gaguritera, tuturo Moses mi gagurisina ainda edo matawa peroveta mane berarimi gaiedo esitera awa.
Awamane tamonde (3) mauntero jiriri nasi aikae edo torain esitera. Edo Yesu mi tepo daginegedo mamain arago esisina.
Ata awamanemi imo torarate atega esitera, “Iji itae esiri turo jijireira. Awatedo, namondekare daedo sima ate.” Edo imo awamanede itain maundo totorisina.
Ango edo imo maundo anumbedo, awamanede daedo tenembada indari inain eite ami bread kundo God ategedo, engegedo awamanede pipisisina.
Edo awamaneda jisi pirigesiri imo kariwa gositera, ata awamaneda toropuda nonda mambarago esisina.
Edo awamane akuta mina tara esitera, “Embo ingenamonde begatada gupeite ge site, Ove Gaiari Matu da udugesira iji ainde, ingenato do yawa bajinabé esira, imo gesi?”
Edo awamane indari tenembada tou edo erido egenembedo Jerusalem maunsitera. Awamane maundo Yesu da embobo 11 ae ambodani neneinde daedo dada doregedo itero taputera.
Edo awamanemi embo tote (2)de sitera, “Badari erira awa gebé! Simon da yai idegesiri ainda jisimi gira!”
Edo embo tote (2)mi Imeasi begatada buro ro idegesira awa tedo, daedo awamanemi Yesu bread engegeteiri kariwa nongo geri, awa tetero gositera.
Yesu ainda ambodanida yai idegesisina.
Ango edo awamane ge matawa site itero, boraebé Yesu awamaneda toropuda idegedo petedo sisina, “Béga itomane yai itare!”
Ata awamane etemi gotera angó kotembedo, boroboro edo adu esitera.
Awatedo, Yesu mi sisina, “Ro awa embo itomane do buriya eiri edo imomane gain darevi?
Nato ipa de tai de eiwa giu! Ane na bé awara. Etemi awa tamopisi de vetu de itae, ata na awa pisi de vetu de gotewa. Eire, tujido giwo!”
Ango tedo, ami ainda ipa de tai de esiri gositera.
Awamanemi Yesu erira awa gido yawa eite korebé esitera, awarata, awamane bé gebé ari tao ae esitera. Awatedo, ine awamanede sisina, “Itomane indari rorae einda isiri? Isira gido awa na piewo inane.”
Ango tesiri awamanemi ainde un wo jiwari ae pika gama de pipisitera.
Edo pietero kundo awamaneda doda injisina.
Yesu mi Ove Gaiari Matuda ge moka ambodanida yai pirigesiri arapa esisina.

Edo Yesu mi awamanede sisina, “Na imondemane daedo matawa isite, nane imondemane tedo eutana, ro nato yai idegaina awa, Moses da Aodarida, edo Peroveta maneda Ove Gaiarida, edo daedo Psalm neneinda gaguritera isira berari awa bé arate.”
Edo ami kondade esiri awamaneda kotembari pirigesisina, Ove Gaiari Matuda tari isira awa, awamaneda yai arapa arate.
Edo awamanede sisina, “Ge ango gaguritera edo God da sirigari matu awa dá ango: Keriso awa memesi budo betaina. Edo amboda, deguta tamonde (3) ainde tekago eraina.

Edo ainda amboda, ainda embomaimi tuturo Jerusalem doda edo maundo embomai butu arapuda, awamaneda yai Keriso da bino dave awa karigara. Edo ainkaimi awamaneda jimbo bebegae dodo God da yai wareregaro, ami awamaneda jimbo kotembedo dowaina.
Imomane namonde daedo itewo buro berari nanemi eono gido etewa. Edo imomane jisimi gewa, na betedo tekago erena. Awatedo, embo neneinde bino berari awa karigewo gore.
Edo giwo! Nanemi ro Mamo natomi tarigari sisina awa piana. Awarata, Jerusalem nasida isiwo, isirawo jirari God mi itomane yai goroba piari bave.
God mi Yesu jiri utuda vivisisina.
Ango edo Yesu awamane gisijido, Jerusalem dodo idegedo pepeta edo Bethany nasida maunsisina. Edo ami ipa jiri eriri awamane ao esisina.
Imo ango eite, awamane dodo taigesiri God mi jiri utuda vivisisina.
Awamanemi wasiri awa gido imo tumondebain esitera. Edo yawa bajinabé eite overegedo Jerusalem maunsitera.
Edo awamane iji berari Judah embomainda oro kotopu bajina doda God ategabutega eite imo dasiga edo esitera. Awara.
